functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Developmentally a separated slip of extensor digitorum longus rather than a fully independent muscle -- absent in a documented minority of individuals, and present at very high frequency (~95%) in humans while rare/near-absent in most anthropoid and hominoid primates, a pattern linked to human bipedal gait; not absolutely unique to humans, however, since it is documented at roughly 30% frequency in gorillas, the one non-human ape with substantial terrestrial locomotion (softened from an overstated 'unique to humans' claim after adversarial fact-check, see docs/VERIFICATION.md).
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
